1.1.en: Blind King Dhritarashtra asks: "What's happening on the battlefield?" The whole Gita is the answer to this one anxious question.
1.1.hi: Andhe raja Dhritarashtra poochte hain: "Battlefield pe kya ho raha hai?" Poori Gita isi ek anxious sawaal ka jawaab hai.

1.2.en: Duryodhana sees the other army lined up and runs straight to his teacher. Nervous energy, trying to look confident.
1.2.hi: Duryodhan saamne ki army dekhta hai aur seedha guru ke paas bhaagta hai. Andar se nervous, bahar se confident.

1.3.en: "Look, teacher, your own student is leading their army." Duryodhana throwing subtle shade at Drona.
1.3.hi: "Dekhiye guruji, aapka hi student unki army lead kar raha hai." Duryodhan ka Drona pe halka sa taunt.

1.4.en: Duryodhana lists the legends on the other side: Bhima, Arjuna, and big names. He's lowkey scared.
1.4.hi: Duryodhan saamne ke legends gin raha hai: Bheem, Arjun aur bade naam. Andar se thoda darra hua hai.

1.5.en: More heavy hitters on the Pandava side. Duryodhana keeps counting threats instead of trusting his own team.
1.5.hi: Pandavon ki taraf aur bhi heavy hitters. Duryodhan apni team pe bharosa karne ki jagah threats gin raha hai.

1.6.en: Young warriors too, including Abhimanyu and Draupadi's sons. Every name makes Duryodhana more anxious.
1.6.hi: Young warriors bhi hain, Abhimanyu aur Draupadi ke bete. Har naam ke saath Duryodhan ki tension badh rahi hai.

1.7.en: Now he hypes his own side: "Let me remind you of our commanders." Classic pep talk to calm himself down.
1.7.hi: Ab apni side ko hype karta hai: "Apne commanders yaad dila doon." Khud ko shaant karne wala pep talk.

1.8.en: Drona, Bhishma, Karna and more. Duryodhana flexing his roster like a fantasy team.
1.8.hi: Drona, Bheeshma, Karna aur bhi. Duryodhan apni team aise flex kar raha hai jaise fantasy league ho.

1.9.en: "So many heroes ready to die for me." When your confidence depends on others, it's shaky.
1.9.hi: "Kitne heroes mere liye jaan dene ko taiyaar hain." Jab confidence dusron pe tika ho, toh woh kamzor hota hai.

1.10.en: "Our army feels weak, theirs feels strong." Comparing yourself to others always messes with your head.
1.10.hi: "Hamari army kamzor lagti hai, unki strong." Dusron se compare karna hamesha dimaag kharab karta hai.

1.11.en: "Everyone, protect Bhishma at all costs!" Duryodhana's whole plan rests on one person. Risky strategy.
1.11.hi: "Sab log Bheeshma ko har haal mein bachao!" Poora plan ek insaan pe tika hai. Risky strategy.

1.12.en: Bhishma roars and blows his conch to boost Duryodhana's mood. The grandpa hype man moment.
1.12.hi: Bheeshma sher ki tarah garajte hain aur shankh bajate hain taaki Duryodhan ka mood bane. Dada ji ka hype moment.

1.13.en: Conches, drums, horns all at once. The noise is insane. Battle soundtrack: on.
1.13.hi: Shankh, dhol, nagade, sab ek saath. Shor zabardast. Battle ka soundtrack: on.

1.14.en: Krishna and Arjuna, on a chariot with white horses, blow their divine conches. Main characters have entered.
1.14.hi: Safed ghodon wale rath pe Krishna aur Arjun apne divya shankh bajate hain. Main characters ki entry.

1.15.en: Every hero has a named conch, like a signature sound. Krishna's is Panchajanya. Iconic.
1.15.hi: Har hero ke shankh ka naam hai, jaise signature sound. Krishna ka Panchajanya. Iconic.

1.16.en: Yudhishthira, Nakula and Sahadeva join in. The Pandava brothers are fully in sync.
1.16.hi: Yudhishthir, Nakul aur Sahadev bhi shamil. Pandav bhai poore sync mein hain.

1.17.en: More warriors answer the call. The Pandava side is loud, united and ready.
1.17.hi: Aur warriors bhi jawaab dete hain. Pandav side loud, united aur ready hai.

1.18.en: Everyone blows their conch again and again. It's a full squad roll call.
1.18.hi: Sab baar-baar shankh bajate hain. Poore squad ka roll call.

1.19.en: The sound shakes earth and sky, and the Kauravas feel it in their hearts. Unity is loud.
1.19.hi: Awaaz dharti-aasmaan hila deti hai, aur Kauravon ke dil kaanp jaate hain. Unity ki awaaz tez hoti hai.

1.20.en: Arjuna, Hanuman on his flag, picks up his bow. The fight is about to begin.
1.20.hi: Arjun, jiske jhande pe Hanuman hain, dhanush uthata hai. Ladai shuru hone wali hai.

1.21.en: Arjuna: "Krishna, take my chariot to the middle." He wants a clear look before the battle.
1.21.hi: Arjun: "Krishna, mera rath beech mein le chalo." Ladai se pehle saaf dekhna chahta hai.

1.22.en: "Let me see who I'm actually up against." Smart move. Know what you're facing.
1.22.hi: "Dekhne do main kis se lad raha hoon." Smart move. Pehle samjho kis cheez ka saamna hai.

1.23.en: Arjuna wants to see who showed up to support Duryodhana's bad choices.
1.23.hi: Arjun dekhna chahta hai ki Duryodhan ke galat decisions ko support karne kaun aaya hai.

1.24.en: Krishna parks the chariot right in front of Bhishma and Drona and says: "Look at them." Plot twist loading.
1.24.hi: Krishna rath ko Bheeshma aur Drona ke saamne rokte hain aur kehte hain: "Dekho inhe." Plot twist loading.

1.25.en: Krishna's "look at them" is deliberate. He knows exactly what Arjuna is about to feel.
1.25.hi: Krishna ka "dekho inhe" soch-samajh ke hai. Unhe pata hai Arjun ab kya feel karega.

1.26.en: Arjuna sees grandfathers, teachers, cousins, friends. The enemy is literally family.
1.26.hi: Arjun dekhta hai dada, guru, cousins, dost. Dushman toh apni hi family hai.

1.27.en: In-laws and close friends on both sides. Suddenly this isn't a war. It's a family breakup.
1.27.hi: Dono taraf sasural wale aur dost. Achanak ye war nahi, family breakup lagne laga.

1.28.en: Arjuna gets hit by a wave of emotion and starts to break down.
1.28.hi: Arjun pe emotions ki lehar aati hai aur woh tootne lagta hai.

1.29.en: Legs weak, mouth dry, body shaking, goosebumps. That's a full panic attack, described thousands of years ago.
1.29.hi: Pair kamzor, munh sookha, body kaanp rahi, rongte khade. Ye poora panic attack hai, hazaaron saal pehle likha hua.

1.30.en: His bow slips, his skin burns, his head spins. Even the greatest warrior can hit a wall.
1.30.hi: Dhanush phisal raha, skin jal rahi, sar ghoom raha. Sabse bada warrior bhi deewar se takra sakta hai.

1.31.en: "I only see bad signs. Nothing good comes from killing my own people."
1.31.hi: "Mujhe sirf bure sign dikh rahe hain. Apno ko maar ke kuch achha nahi hoga."

1.32.en: "I don't want the win, the throne or the luxury. What's the point of any of it?" Total burnout energy.
1.32.hi: "Mujhe jeet, raaj ya luxury kuch nahi chahiye. Iska point kya hai?" Total burnout energy.

1.33.en: "The people I'd want to share the success with are the ones standing here to fight."
1.33.hi: "Jinke saath success share karni thi, wahi log yahan ladne khade hain."

1.34.en: Teachers, fathers, sons, uncles, in-laws: Arjuna sees them all as his own people. That's the pain.
1.34.hi: Guru, pita, bete, chacha, sasural wale: Arjun ko sab apne lagte hain. Dard yahi hai.

1.35.en: "Even for all three worlds I wouldn't kill them, let alone for this earth."
1.35.hi: "Teenon lok mil jaayein tab bhi inhe nahi maarunga, yeh dharti toh kya cheez hai."

1.36.en: "Even if they're wrong, what joy is there in destroying them? It'll only leave guilt."
1.36.hi: "Galat hain toh bhi, inhe khatam karke kya khushi milegi? Sirf guilt bachega."

1.37.en: "How could we ever be happy after killing our own family?" Arjuna's heart is overruling everything.
1.37.hi: "Apni family ko maar ke hum kaise khush rahenge?" Arjun ka dil sab pe haavi hai.

1.38.en: "They're blinded by greed and don't see the damage. But we can see it."
1.38.hi: "Woh greed mein andhe hain, nuksaan nahi dekh rahe. Par hum toh dekh sakte hain."

1.39.en: "If we know this is wrong, why shouldn't we walk away?" Arjuna building his case to quit.
1.39.hi: "Jab pata hai ye galat hai, toh hum peeche kyun na hatein?" Arjun quit karne ka case bana raha hai.

1.40.en: "When families fall apart, traditions and values go with them, and chaos follows."
1.40.hi: "Jab family toot-ti hai, toh values aur traditions bhi chale jaate hain, aur chaos aa jaata hai."

1.41.en: Arjuna worries society will lose its moral compass if this war happens. Big-picture fear.
1.41.hi: Arjun ko darr hai ki is war se society ka moral compass kho jaayega. Big-picture darr.

1.42.en: He fears the damage will hit generations, even the ancestors. His anxiety is now going full worst-case.
1.42.hi: Usse lagta hai nuksaan peedhiyon tak jaayega, purvajon tak bhi. Anxiety ab worst-case mode mein hai.

1.43.en: "Those who break families destroy traditions that took ages to build."
1.43.hi: "Jo family todte hain, woh sadiyon ki traditions khatam kar dete hain."

1.44.en: "We've heard that people who destroy family values suffer badly." Fear is doing the talking now.
1.44.hi: "Suna hai jo family values todte hain, woh bura bhugatte hain." Ab darr bol raha hai.

1.45.en: "We're about to do something terrible just for power and comfort." Guilt hits hard.
1.45.hi: "Sirf power aur aaram ke liye hum kuch bahut galat karne ja rahe hain." Guilt zor se lagta hai.

1.46.en: "I'd rather let them kill me, unarmed, than fight." Arjuna is ready to give up completely.
1.46.hi: "Main bina hathiyar ke mar jaana pasand karunga, ladne se." Arjun poori tarah haar maanne ko taiyaar hai.

1.47.en: Arjuna drops his bow, sits down, and breaks. Rock bottom. And this is exactly where the Gita begins.
1.47.hi: Arjun dhanush gira deta hai, baith jaata hai, toot jaata hai. Rock bottom. Aur Gita yahin se shuru hoti hai.
